> **Observed:** 2026-09-15T02:24:15Z
> **Do not edit this file. Edit the derived wiki page instead.**

Vik said "I restarted" after publication of the W1.8.4.4 input-path and short-reference repair at Loci b2f2664. The primary invoked the installed MCP tools directly. The restarted host now returns the complete captureCommandResult -> CaptureCommandResultOptions -> WorkContextBinding path from the function name alone, with parameter, options-field, import, public re-export, target-definition and resolution-control evidence. Its item and source references are 30 characters. The previous exact-old-v2 response and restart requirement remain historical evidence, not the current state.

Six actual retrievals return function-only 16268 bytes, richer question 14846, explicit pair 16161, binding file 16162, browser 16245 and renderer 15523, with 6/4/5/11/5/6 relationship records. Browser and renderer retain the required forward body calls and reverse callers. These are the retained local request/output expectations; partial coverage and all omissions remain explicit.

Three actual reads pass returned handles unchanged. The function's full 4468-byte extent completes in one page. The 14082-byte binding file completes in two contiguous pages, offsets 0:8192 and 8192:14082. Read envelopes are 5108, 9078 and 6575 bytes. The retained 638-file snapshot matches its original manifest with no missing/extra files or symlinks. Complete expected results, source/hash/spans, linked proof and exact paging are independently assessed by Sol/high activation_evidence, whose bounded validation artifact accompanies the primary's nine original request/result objects. No Astra subagent, product edit or provider trial was used. The 66 passing local implementation tests remain prior evidence, not newly rerun tests.

The evidence establishes installed-host activation of the selected repair. Original raw MCP result objects are retained; reduced Code Mode summaries do not establish full outer model-visible delivery, a completed provider interval, internal model reliance or population-level adoption. Static coverage remains non-exhaustive, and unsupported signature roles are still qualified.

The selected repair and activation work is finished. W1.8.4.4 and the broader ordinary-value Objective remain open: the previous two-binding measurement has median input 479060, 1.921636 times its original baseline, with strict-answer and historical-review comparability caveats. No token savings follow merely from activation. Recommended next W1.8.4.4 is a separately selected and newly frozen two-binding comparison using fresh Terra/high agents, unchanged original prompts/source and 1.25-times cost thresholds. This restart verification selects or launches no additional campaign.
